name: bundled-plpgsql
sql:
CREATE TRUSTED LANGUAGE plpgsql_fixture
  HANDLER plpgsql_call_handler
  INLINE plpgsql_inline_handler
  VALIDATOR plpgsql_validator

name: qualified-nonvoid-optional-routines
sql: CREATE LANGUAGE sample HANDLER pg_catalog.plpgsql_call_handler INLINE callbacks.inline_handler VALIDATOR callbacks.validator

name: different-signature-does-not-shadow
sql: CREATE LANGUAGE sample HANDLER plpgsql_call_handler VALIDATOR validator_shadow

name: wrong-validator-signature
sql: CREATE LANGUAGE sample HANDLER plpgsql_call_handler VALIDATOR public.validator

name: missing-inline-handler
sql: CREATE LANGUAGE sample HANDLER plpgsql_call_handler INLINE public.missing

name: replace
sql: CREATE OR REPLACE LANGUAGE existing_language HANDLER plpgsql_call_handler

name: duplicate-function-declaration
sql: CREATE FUNCTION public.validator(integer) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql AS 'SELECT NULL::text'
